title: Current acknowledged Runtime Host control lease refresh
$comment: Runtime-proof JSON body only. The active current tuple, binding, assignment, cell incarnation and acknowledged control generation must remain authoritative. A matching expiry CAS issues a fresh jti with monotonically increasing expiry, capped by the current heartbeat lease and 120 seconds, without changing controlGeneration. A lower expected expiry returns the current committed lease without extending it; a higher expiry or stale generation rejects. Each HTTP retry signs a new one-use Runtime proof. The existing /v1/assign keeps takeover semantics. The Cell accepts auth-refresh only on its current owner socket.
